text:
Maria: quick handoff — I'm about to start a smokebench for the int4→FP8 variant used in canary. Need someone to monitor perf + regression on quality for seq len 512/1024. Starting in ~15m.
Ajay: I can take 15-45. which model and prompt set?
Maria: model: gptx-3b-quant-int4-fp8 (branch: quant/hybrid-sched). promptset: /evals/regression/promptsets/qtrade_short.json. target SLO: p95 latency < 60ms, top-1 token quality delta < 0.3% over baseline.
Sam: pinging @lisa and @bench-bot. I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421 — adds conservative KV caching flag. needs quick review if cache semantics affect tail latency.
Lisa: I'll skim PR now. major risk is KV off-by-one at seq rollover — will add a small test. expecting ~10-15m.
bench-bot: benchmark job queued (id: 89234). runner: r1-small, seeds: 3, batches: auto.
Ajay: when you run, include `--profile-kv` and `--batching=continuous`. also capture `latency_histogram` and `mem_peak`.
Maria: noted. command I'll run:
```
./run_bench --model gptx-3b-quant-int4-fp8 --seq-lens 512,1024 --promptset qtrade_short.json \
  --runs 3 --batching continuous --profile-kv --save /tmp/qbench/89234
```
Sam: add `--force-fallback=int8` for one run so we can compare fallback behavior.
Maria: good call — will do two runs per seed (hybrid + fallback).
bench-bot: job 89234: started (2026-03-17T18:02:10Z). allocating GPU pool a2.
Ajay: FYI please keep an eye on seq=1024 p99, we saw a small spike yesterday during soft-rollout.
Maria: first seed run done. quick stats (hybrid): p50 21ms, p95 58ms, p99 130ms, throughput 400 tok/s. fallback run p95 65ms, p99 160ms. saving logs to /tmp/qbench/89234/log1.json
Lisa: those p99s are higher than baseline — can you attach sample traces? `trace_id` would help.
Maria: attached trace id: trace-89234-1. baseline p99 was ~95ms for int8. seems like int4→fp8 combo helped p50/p95 but hurts tail.
Sam: interesting — could be batching interaction with KV cache miss. Ajay, can you profile kernel occupancy for the p99 events?
Ajay: on it. grabbing async profile now. if it's cache-miss, we may need to tweak `kv_prefetch_window` to 8.
bench-bot: job 89234: seed 2 started. ETA ~7m.
Maria: quick note — I'm going to open a short issue with artifacts + sample prompts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/issues/178 — will tag the experiment files.
Lisa: thanks. If we want to proceed with canary, we need a mitigation plan: either limit hybrid to seq<=512 or enable p99 circuit-breaker to fallback automatically.
Sam: +1 to circuit-breaker. also we should add a small eval that measures hallucination/quality on the same promptset; even small perf gains not worth quality regression.
Maria: included quality pass — short eval run after benchmarks, will post numbers.
Ajay: profiling snapshot: tail events show kernel stalls when `kv_load` spikes. suggestion: prefetch + reduce `max_batch_tokens` from 2048 to 1024 for seq=1024 runs.
Maria: rerunning second seed with `--kv-prefetch 8 --max-batch-tokens 1024`. starting now.
bench-bot: job 89234: updated params, run 2 started (2026-03-17T18:18:55Z).
Maria: run 2 results (hybrid + prefetch): p50 23ms, p95 60ms, p99 98ms, throughput 380 tok/s. tail improved a lot.
Lisa: that's promising. can you paste the small eval quality delta?
Maria: quality pass (BLEU-like proxy): baseline 0.942, hybrid w/o prefetch 0.938 (-0.4%), hybrid w/ prefetch 0.940 (-0.2%).
Sam: delta seems within noise. proposal: canary with prefetch enabled and p99 circuit-breaker threshold at 120ms, monitor for 24h.
Ajay: agree. also create an alert on `kv_miss_rate` > 0.05.
Maria: I'll file the canary plan and schedule a monitor run. tagging @oncall in case alerts fire.
Lisa: I can merge the PR after a quick unit test added. will do within the hour.
Sam: thanks all. if no objections, I'll push the canary config later today.
Maria: no objections here. thanks team :thumbsup: I'll leave artifacts in /reports/qbench/89234 and update the issue.
bench-bot: job 89234: completed. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/qbench/89234
Ajay: nice work. closing loop: update the playbook with `--kv-prefetch` recommendation and the p99 action.
Lisa: done — PR to docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/90
Sam: closing thread, will create canary ticket with rollout steps.
